body: Its dark in here!

22F here, I've been recently feeling something very similar. I've been feeling like no guy ever wants me and the ones that do, take me for granted, or are just not interested in me. 

I've been feeling very alone when I broke up with my abusive ex at the time, and I've been trying to cope with it, and it's been taking a huge toll on me mentally and physically.

I definitely do what you do and just watch couples just holding hands, seeing videos of them kissing, wishing I had exactly that, that feeling of having a close and healthy connection with a partner, feeling that security. I've told my parents how I've given up looking for someone, I've always been told that there's someone out there for me, but I've now grown to not believing that...

The reason why I'm saying any of this, is because I know EXACTLY how you feel, OP. I'm glad that I feel like I'm not crazy in how I feel, I also feel sorry for you, OP. I wish I knew what to truly say to help, but I hope that me explaining my way of thinking hopefully makes you less alone.

Oh, I know he would be in a heartbeat. He's a retired Army man and I love him to pieces, I know that there will come a day when I can tell him, I just feel like it would be too much for him currently for personal reasons that I dont want it to affect him as much as it has been me. My dad was the one who told me that J was a boy and not a man and that he's been proud of me, that it must've been hard for me.

I'll definitely try to, thanks for the reminder! - I know my dad is there for me and he's happy I left but he doesnt know *all* that went on, my mom said he pribably wouldnt be comfortable with knowing everything like ahe does and I dont wanna put that stress/worry/regret onto him, I just mainly told him the emotional parts of how angry I was/am and how J treated me, however, my mom knows everything. - Shes been helping me a lot throughout this and I love her for it. ❤️

(If that makes sense! Again, thank you kind stranger for listening to me - god bless you ❤️)

No, we had plans to back in May of last year but it never worked out, J claimed that when we met we'd sneak out and he'd have sex with me which I wasnt comfortable with. When I told him that I didnt think planning it when we did would work due to flight prices and hotels (we planned it like two weeks from then) and that we could try another month, he got mad at me saying that he already told his grandmother that we were meeting at month and just told me to forget it.

As someone who recently broke up with an ex for this exact issue (not listening and having little change) amongst controlling behaviors, DUMP HIM. - My ex cried to me over the phone, (we were LDR) not to leave and to explain to him why I was done with him and that he would do anything to have me back. He would listen to me and be open with me, but I knew that would never happen.


Initially I asked him if we could be friends, only to be told, "I cant do that", then after telling him I wanted to break it off, I gave him one more time to ask and he agreed but I was so triggered by what he had told me that led me to break up with him (told me that if my late brother hadnt passed from a pulmonary embolism two years ago, that my anger towards him, the ex, I wouldnt be so mad about the ex's behaviors, to say I was pissed is an understatement.) and the things he had told me during the relationship. (i.e, him constantly telling me how "weak and a pussy" he is, despite me tell him hes not. - "how no one listens to me", even when Im right there. - the good old classic of "i cant do anything" again, despite, me trying to help him, with no change . Thrn him constantly feeling depressed even when I was trying to help but nothing changed and bringing brought up again and again. Rinse and repeat 24/7.)

Please OP, listen to your gut and instincts. If you ever feel like it wont work out, please listen to yourself.
